meta.title: The Third Cup
meta.logline: DEMO STORYBOARD (fictional): a grandmother's coffee ceremony teaches her grandson that the third cup, the blessing, is the one you stay for.
meta.audience: Fictional demo audience: young Ethiopians in the diaspora who grew up hearing about the coffee ceremony but rarely sat through one.
meta.intent: Viewers should feel the patience of the ceremony and want to call someone older than them.

style.block: Warm hand-painted gouache illustration, soft paper grain, muted ochre, terracotta and deep green palette, gentle window light, quiet and intimate mood.
style.negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry face

characters.name: Etetu
characters.description: a fictional Ethiopian grandmother in her seventies, kind deep-set eyes, short grey hair under a white netela shawl with a thin green border, small cross tattoo on her forehead, simple white habesha dress

voice.style_instruction: Read in Amharic slowly and warmly, like an elder telling a story to a grandchild at night. Leave small pauses between sentences.

music.caption: gentle Ethiopian krar and soft strings, tizita mood, warm, nostalgic, sparse, intimate acoustic, slow build, no drums

cues.note: strings enter under the third cup
resolve and fade over the end card

shots.reason: Establish the place and time: a quiet compound at dawn.

keyframe.prompt: A small mud-brick house with a corrugated roof in a green highland village at dawn, mist over eucalyptus trees, smoke rising from the roof

narration.english: Every morning, my grandmother made coffee.

shots.reason: Introduce Etetu with her hands, the ritual's first gesture.

keyframe.prompt: Etetu sits on a low stool spreading fresh green grass on the floor beside a small charcoal stove, window light from the left

motion.prompt: she slowly scatters grass with one hand, steam drifts, camera static

narration.english: First, she spreads the fresh grass.

shots.reason: The sound and smoke of roasting beans pull the viewer in.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of green coffee beans roasting dark brown in a flat iron pan over glowing charcoal, thin curls of smoke

motion.prompt: beans shift as the pan is shaken, smoke curls upward, camera static

narration.english: As the beans roast, the whole house fills with the smell.

shots.reason: The grandson's point of view: he is impatient, which sets up the lesson.

keyframe.prompt: A teenage boy in a hoodie sits across the room looking at a phone, soft focus jebena coffee pot in the foreground

narration.text: እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ቸኩዬ ነበር። አንድ ሲኒ ጠጥቼ መሄድ እፈልግ ነበር።
narration.english: But I was always in a hurry. I wanted one cup and then to leave.

shots.reason: The first cup, abol, served with care.

keyframe.prompt: Etetu's hands pour dark coffee from a black clay jebena in a high thin stream into small white cups on a wooden tray

motion.prompt: a steady thin stream of coffee pours into the cup, slight steam, camera pushes in gently

narration.english: The first cup is called abol.

shots.reason: Time passes: second cup, the light has moved.

keyframe.prompt: The room in afternoon light, Etetu and two neighbours sit on low stools talking around the coffee tray, frankincense smoke in the air

narration.text: ሁለተኛው ቶና። ጎረቤቶች ይመጣሉ፣ ወሬ ይጀመራል።
narration.english: The second is tona. Neighbours arrive, the talking begins.

shots.reason: The turn: the third cup is the blessing, and he stays.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of Etetu smiling gently and offering a small white cup toward the camera with both hands, warm evening light

motion.prompt: she slowly extends the cup forward and smiles, camera static

narration.text: ሦስተኛው በረካ ነው። ምርቃቱ። ያን ቀን፣ ቆየሁ።
narration.english: The third is bereka, the blessing. That day, I stayed.

shots.reason: Let the music breathe on a quiet image before the ending.

keyframe.prompt: Extreme close-up of an empty white coffee cup on a wooden tray, last light, a few roasted beans beside it

shots.reason: Close the loop to the present and give the viewer something to do.

keyframe.prompt: The same mud-brick house at dusk, warm light in the window, smoke rising, first stars

narration.text: ዛሬም፣ ቡና ሳፈላ፣ ሦስተኛውን ሲኒ እጠብቃለሁ።
narration.english: Even today, when I make coffee, I wait for the third cup.
